name: Essence of the Exile
objectiveText: Progress The cauldron bubbles.  Its vapors beckon... Thundering Charm  ( 8 ) Burning Charm  ( 8 ) Cresting Charm  ( 8 )

comments.body:
The drop rate is actually excellent without starting the whole Princess Trapped quest line.  I've taken two warriors through this Whirlwind quest line now and never had a problem with the drop rate.

The elementals you need to kill are around levels 38 - 39 so be prepared for them.  Drop every 3 or so kills there are a lot of elementals at the various locations but you may find yourself sharing the areas due to people who farm them for their elemental drops (air, fire and water)

Lots of great info with no straight answers.

HERE IS THE WALKTHROUGH!


The Quest Giver

Go see Bath'rah for the quest. He is just NORTH of Tarren Mill on the EAST SHORE of the river that flows from Southshore to Tarren Mill. From Southshore follow the river north PAST Tarren Mill. Walk on the East Shore.... he will be off to your right in a gazeebo...if you miss him please uninstall WoW and go outside and play.

The Charms 

You need Thundering, Burning, and Cresting Exile charms that drop from these mobs. YOU NEED 8 OF EACH. You can find them in the Arathi Highlands not too far from  Refuge Point. One JUST to the east near the cliff at Refuge Point, one near the big wall in the north west and one at the top center of the map. The drop rate is VERY low so be prepared to camp each spot for a good long time.


The Bloodscalp Tusks

Go kill Bloodscalp Trolls in Stranglethorn Vale. You will need to collect 30 of their tusks from their corpses'.


Liferoot

If you are Herbalist you most likely already have this herb. If not ask around in the trade channels or the AH.


Return to Bath'rah

When you have all of these items you need to return to Bath'rah's camp and click on the bubbling cauldron in front of his gazeebo. You will create an "Essence of Exile" from the charms. Talk to Bath'rah and give him the items..... he will ask you to follow him. FOLLOW HIM. He will summon Cyclonian. Prepare for an ass beating!


The popular choice of weapon to select as your prize is the AXE. You wont be sorry if you get it!

Ack! Don't be fooled by the droprate of the charms! To get this droprate, you have to start another quest chain. East / Northeast of Refuge Pointe is a circle of stones. Floating in the center is a large Dark Crystal (shout-out to Jim Henson). This starts a quest chain, the first quest being "The Princess Trapped" (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=642) After completing the first chain of the quest, you will receive the second portion, "Stones of Binding" (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=651). This is when the droprate kicks in. In this quest, you must get the 3 keys from the 3 circle of bindings. ONCE YOU GET THE KEYS, then you will FINALLY begin to get the charms. So make sure to start this other chain of quests. You can sometimes purchase the crests in the AH, but they are expensive and you can't always find the ones you need.
